plugins.name: go-practices-plugin
plugins.description: Go code quality, conventions, and testing rules covering standard library-first HTTP services, pgx database access, error handling, and BDD-style testing with testify

plugins.name: engineering-practices-plugin
plugins.description: Language-agnostic engineering practices including conventional commits, PR discipline, spec-linked delivery, ADRs, and definition of done, with a /pr-description command and a reusable pull request template

plugins.name: agentic-development-plugin
plugins.description: Agentic development workflow with spec, research, plan, and implement commands following a human-in-the-loop phased approach

plugins.name: technical-writing-plugin
plugins.description: Technical writing discipline based on ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English — one meaning per word, active voice, simple tenses, short sentences — applied to READMEs, ADRs, runbooks, API docs, error messages, and commit messages
